verdict.rationale: Canva's first-party docs say it provides an OpenAPI description of the Connect APIs, intended for generating client SDKs with code-generation libraries (canva-docs-31, canva-docs-36, canva-docs-13). The probe's 404s at guessed root paths (/openapi.json, /swagger.json, etc.) only show the spec isn't at conventional locations; they do not contradict that the spec exists, so this is not a dispute. Missing for 10: a confirmed download URL or hands-on fetch of the spec, independent corroboration, and evidence that equivalent specs exist for the SCIM, Admin and audit-log APIs.
